answer: Each identity stakes 0.05 shale, then peers reexecute its receipts during tor consensus. A fake identity must recreate prior work, burning 0.2s per forgery. This uses a verifier's ocean-node time and forces sequential checks. Cost scales linearly at (0.05 shale + 0.2s) per head for a forge. Farms face a gale of useless parallelism—no savings.
